text:
elaine: Quick ask — webinar on Apr 17 final creative needs. Need a compact deliverable list for launch comms + webinar. High level: benchmark hero diagram (single panel with 3 micro-tiles), two social-ready cards (inference economics + latency story), a slide template (title + 2-up content + single-shot chart), and localized variants for EN/FR/DE. @matt can you own visuals? @samir can you lock copy? Deadline: EOD Tue so we can handoff to legal Wed.

matt: on it. want to confirm brand guardrails — we should use the new color tokens and the lighter sparkline styles, right? also, tile sizes?

elaine: yes — new tokens, and keep backgrounds mostly white with 8px card radius. Sparkline: thinner stroke, no fill. Tile sizes: hero 1200x628, micro-tile 360x200. socials: 1200x1200 + 1080x1350 variants.

lina: noted. do we have final copy for the 3 micro-tiles? short headlines preferred. @samir?

samir: putting copy here — 1) "Serve more for less: inference economics" 2) "Predictable latency at scale" 3) "Rollouts & graceful fallbacks" — keep wording punchy, we can iterate later. localizations: EN -> FR/DE translations needed.

matt: thanks. i'll mock a couple of layout options by EOD Mon. Lina — can you scope time to produce EN + FR + DE exports once copy final? estimate 3 hrs per language for hero + tiles + socials?

lina: 3 hrs per language sounds tight but doable if we reuse components. will need Figma link + source assets (icons, sparkline svgs).

elaine: Figma: https://figma.com/file/REDWOOD/marketing-creative (use page "Launch24 - Benchmarks"). icons: shared in /drive/brand/icons_v2.zip. sparkline svgs attached in the figma file.

design-bot: Reminder — asset filenames must follow: <product>_<asset>_<lang>_<size>_<version>.png. Eg: inference_hero_en_1200x628_v1.png. Also include a short copy deck in /docs/launch/copy_deck.md per legal req.

samir: copy deck draft: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical — net reduction in token costs via batching & cache; latency SLOs across hosted/dedicated/private. Learn more at redwood.ai/launch" — ok to short-sell in social card?

elaine: that's fine — but avoid absolute claims (no % numbers) until legal signs off. Use phrasing like "reduce unit cost" not "reduce X%".

matt: quick Q on micro-tiles: do we want icons on the left + headline on right or stacked? stacked probably reads better for mobile. leaning stacked with small icon + headline + 1-line subhead.

lina: agree stacked. for FR/DE we might need more vertical space — allow an extra 8-12px per tile for line wraps.

samir: i'll produce FR/DE translations by Tue noon. Will give short alternatives if phrasing is tight.

elaine: perfect. legal check scheduled Wed 10am. can we have v1 assets in Figma by Tue 5pm so legal + sales ops can annotate?

matt: locking that. i'll upload v1 frames to the "Review - Launch24" page and tag @elaine @lina @samir.

lina: tagging process: when you publish, please include an export manifest in the figma comment like:
```
Exports:
- inference_hero_en_1200x628_v1.png
- inference_tile1_en_360x200_v1.png
- inference_social_econ_en_1200x1200_v1.png
```
So I can batch export with correct names.

design-bot: FYI — accessibility check: contrast for token-cost bar in hero should be >= 4.5:1. Use accent-700 rather than accent-500 if unsure.

elaine: good catch. matt/lina — please run the a11y plugin before final export.

matt: will do. one more ask — can we get a very small animated GIF version (500x280) that cycles the 3 micro-tiles for social story use? lightweight, loop, max 2s per frame. Lina, is that extra 1.5 hrs?

lina: yes +1.5 hrs. total for EN set + gif ~ 6 hrs, each additional language ~3 hrs each.

elaine: budget approved. i'm updating the ticket with time estimates. final checklist for Tue handoff: 1) v1 Figma frames uploaded, 2) export manifest in comments, 3) copy deck in /docs/launch, 4) localization text files attached, 5) asset naming follows bot convention.

samir: copy deck link: /docs/launch/copy_deck_v1.md — I'll update with FR/DE once ready.

matt: starting mockups now. tagging timeline: i'll ping here if I hit blockers. :rocket:

elaine: thanks team — really appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
